coverage.assessment: Three chains lose their links in revision: why Adams inserted the Agassiz sentence (F3), why he locks up psychology (F5), and why the specie finding endangers him and calls for caution (F6). The Pendennis setup survives but is flattened (F7).
Wenlock, the Abbey and the Milnes Gaskells are grounded, and Rome, London and Liverpool are clear. 'Horseshoe, or Limulus' slightly blurs who named the creature but does not mislead materially.

There is no performed dialogue. The reported exchanges with Lyell (the review offer, Terebratula, the first vertebrate) keep the right asker and answerer, and the inserted Agassiz sentence is quoted intact.
'First in an infinite series of ancestors' changes the paradox and drops the ancestors' unchanging Truths (F1). Other quantifiers and the price figures are preserved.
'As the path ultimately led' survives. Other retrospect markers, such as 'thirty years to wait' and the editor's-letter self-assessment, were cut (F8, tradeoff).
The anchors survive, but the Wenlock place-and-time series and the self-mocking surprise at Lyell's assent are stripped (F2, F7).
Adams's lack of Faith loses its foil: Lyell's and the other Darwinians' religious hope (F4). The 'their thought was one' unity contrast is lost in F1.
All three dependencies are intact at both endpoints. Separately, the optional-list instruction to keep one of the Bluebeard/Hamlet asides was not followed (F5).

findings.claim: The revision cuts the ancestors who all held one unchanging Truth. It then patches the next sentence so that Adams becomes 'first' within a series of ancestors, rather than the first in an infinite line to admit indifference to truth.

strengths: All eight verbatim anchors (V1–V8) survive intact, including the poodle image and 'Darwinian for fun'.
Required glosses are handled cleanly: Wenlock Abbey as 'the home of his English friends the Milnes Gaskells', 'his earlier historical article' for Pocahontas, and Ara Coeli dated to 1860.
The 'five or ten thousand million dollars' and 'five thousand millions more' price echo is preserved exactly.
The La Fontaine verse, the Agassiz insertion and the Paley-watch/coal-power argument are kept in the author's wording.
summary: The revision keeps every verbatim anchor, the planned glosses (Milnes Gaskell, Pocahontas, Ara Coeli 1860), the price continuity and all three dependencies. The problems are new cuts made in revision, not in the first draft. One patched sentence misstates the ancestry paradox. Several argumentative hinges also lose their connecting links: the glacial heresy, the Darwinians' faith as a foil, the motive for locking up psychology, and the publish-or-perish dilemma. The Wenlock meditation, the plan's flagged risk, is flattened.
